newsitem.title: USA: Harley construction projects on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Harley construction projects on schedule.

text.p: Harley-Davidson Inc said construction of a new manufacturing plant in Kansas City, Mo. is proceeding on schedule, as is construction in the Milwaukee area of a new product development center and a parts and accessories distribution center.

"Due to the expected improved efficiencies of the new P&A distribution center and the new progressive work environment, an early retirement program was offered by Harley-Davidson and accepted by a number of union-represented employees, resulting in a third-quarter charge of $2.5 million," Harley said.

Harley reported third-quarter profits of $33.2 million, or $0.44 per share, on sales of $385.8 million. Profits the year before in the same period were $23.6 million, or $0.32 per share, on sales of $327 million.
"We expect to begin moving our employees into the new product development center in January and into the new P&A distribution center by year-end," Harley said.

"We also completed the purchase of an existing manufacturing facility in the Milwaukee area and are currently developing a detailed plan regarding the separation of our powertrain operations into two manufacturing facilities," said the U.S. motorcycle manufacturer.
